summary: Wheeler Real Estate Investment Trust filed an 8-K reporting routine monthly conversions of its Series D Cumulative Convertible Preferred Stock into common stock, triggering an adjustment to the conversion price of its 7.00% Subordinated Convertible Notes due 2031. The filing details that 7,700 Series D shares were redeemed at ~$41.07 per share via issuance of 251,090 common shares, with a volume-weighted average price of ~$1.26. As of June 5, 2026, 2,194,353 common and 1,765,162 Series D shares outstanding. This is a standard ongoing redemption process, not a special situation event.
